parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify($json.supplierWindowOpen
  ? { messaging_product: "whatsapp", to: $json.supplier.phone, type: "text",
      text: { body: "New job " + $json.reference + ": " + $json.detail + ". Reply YES " + $json.reference + " to accept." } }
  : { messaging_product: "whatsapp", to: $json.supplier.phone, type: "template",
      template: { name: "job_dispatch", language: { code: "en" },
        components: [{ type: "body", parameters: [
          { type: "text", text: $json.reference },
          { type: "text", text: $json.detail } ] }] } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: "whatsapp", to: $('Dispatch Brain').first().json.clientPhone || $('Dispatch Brain').first().json.to, type: "text", text: { body: $('Dispatch Brain').first().json.clientText || $('Dispatch Brain').first().json.text || "Update on your job." } }) }}
